summary.one_liner: A small macOS app that fixes muted or unresponsive system sound, mainly after attaching an HDMI monitor used for video only, by restarting the coreaudiod daemon.
summary.what_it_does: The app targets a bug where the Mac's primary sound output goes mute and ignores mute, volume, output-device changes, or headphone attachment, which the README says can happen when an HDMI monitor is used for video only. When run, it kills the system's coreaudiod daemon, and macOS restarts it automatically, which the README says restores sound. The app then closes itself after a successful restart. The README includes screenshots of the initial screen, main window, an authentication step, and the solved state. The README says the app may help with other sound-related issues but asks users to report those cases.
use_cases: fix mac sound muted after connecting hdmi monitor
fix sound not switching to headphones on mac
notable: Restarts coreaudiod instead of requiring a full reboot
Closes itself after the sound daemon restarts
Targets sound loss when an HDMI monitor is used for video only
caveats: README warns it has not been tested after Mojave
README describes it as a simple workaround for one specific bug, not a general audio fix
Requires authentication when run, per the screenshot section
